Name: Bear Mount
Author: RavengerMRIB
Description:
An update to PenguinTuxedo's Bear mod, whom gave permission for changes to be made to his original mod.  Changes in the in-game horse into a rideable bear.  

All I did was clean up some of the errant pixels from the original mod.   One major change however, in order to remove a large batch of pixels from one of the bear's idle animations, I had to remove the riding head overlay as the sprite for the bear's head was so wide, it would clip into the sprites used for other animations, meaning in short, when you're riding the bear directly at the camera the character's legs may look a little wonky (See Image 3).  Though I prefer this to a large batch of floating pixels, I apologize if this annoys anyone.  

This only changes the look of the horse, all sounds associated with it are unaltered.  Though, the only sounds to my knowledge are the hoof beats, so again, this may not be that big a deal.  

This is my first time modding Stardew in any way shape or form, along with uploading a file, so I 'hope' I'm going about everything correctly.  

To install, just simply replace the existing horse.xnb file in the Animals folder that is located in StardewValley/Content with the modded file.  I recommend backing up the existing file into a folder of your choice, just incase you're not happy with the mod and wish to change it back.

You have my full permission to edit/alter this mod to your liking.
